verdict.rationale: Shortcut is a project-management and issue-tracking tool that connects to external coding agents such as Cursor, Claude Code and Codex through its MCP server. Having an agent navigate a running app and capture before-and-after screenshots to verify its own implementation is a coding or browser-agent capability, outside this product's category. Nothing in the evidence shows Shortcut itself ships such an agent, so the axis does not apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have an agent verify its own implementation by navigating the app and capturing before-and-after screenshots
